2018 Q4.bq: Under the new guidance, we now estimate royalty revenue for the current reporting quarter and will true-up this estimate to actuals in the subsequent period when the royalty reports are received.

2019 Q1.gq: We now expect revenue from royalties to range from $72 million to $74 million, lower than our prior expectation of flat year-over-year royalties, with a decrease primarily attributable to the greater impact of biosimilars in Europe and updated expectations on Roche's US launch products.

2019 Q3.gq: We now expect total revenue to be in the range of $195 million to $205 million compared to our prior guidance of $205 million to $215 million, driven by the movement of the planned Phase III start from 2019 into 2020, offset in part by the new target nomination by Roche.

2020 Q1.gq: So in summary, based on all of the latest updates from our partners and suppliers as well as our planned expenditures, we feel confident maintaining our guidance for 2020 at this time.

2020 Q3.gq: We now expect total revenues of $250 million to $260 million, up from our prior guidance of $230 million to $245 million, which would represent year-over-year growth of 28% to 33%.

2021 Q1.gq: Consistent with the strong growth we're seeing for our business, we are reiterating our guidance for total revenues of $375 million to $395 million, which would represent year-over-year growth of 40% to 48%.

2021 Q2.gq: We are pleased to be raising guidance for 2021 based on our latest collaboration with Viiv and the strong results so far in the first half of the year.

2021 Q3.gq: Revenue guidance is increased to $430 million to $445 million, which represents growth of 61 percent to 66 percent over prior year.

2025 Q3.gq: Based on our strong performance year to date, we are raising our guidance ranges for the full year.

2026 Q1.gq: So in our earlier guidance this year, obviously, we did not make any assumptions for levels of buyback and also today in the guidance that we are reiterating does not include any potential impact from the share repurchases that we will do this year.

2026 Q2.gq: As Helen mentioned earlier, we are pleased to raise the guidance for the remainder of the year.
2026 Q2.bq: Royalty revenue of $307.7 million increased 50% from $205.6 million in the prior year period and exceeded our expectations.
